description: A Kivy application demonstrating URL requests, handling responses including images and JSON data, with UI components for user interaction.

classes.name: UrlExample
classes.description: A Kivy App class that manages URL requests, response handling, and UI updates.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Loads the UI layout from the KV string.

methods.name: fetch_content
methods.description: Initiates a URL request and handles cleanup before sending.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Resets the UI state and internal properties.

methods.name: on_success
methods.description: Handles successful URL responses, saving images or displaying JSON/text.

methods.name: on_failure
methods.description: Handles failed URL requests, displaying error info.

methods.name: on_error
methods.description: Handles errors during URL requests, displaying error message.
